{{Quote|Pitor, I'm sorry I doubted you, but that thing is ''not'' the bogeyman! It's an ''IG-100 MagnaGuard'' with a faulty neural processor, basic droid assembly skills and a ''bad'' attitude!|[[Rex/Legends|Rex]], to [[Pitor]]|<ref name="A Small Scrappy War!" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place at [[Biitu]]'s [[Pitor Processing Plantworks]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Reanimator]] led his reanimated [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droids]] against [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]].
